''See also: [[Calan Archer Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Calan Archer is a muscular, sandy-haired member of the [[Stormcallers]], a cult dedicated to the [[Weeping Dragon]]. He is characterized by a serious demeanor, a square jaw, and a facial scar. His physical appearance includes broad shoulders and scripted rings of blue-and-gold lightning around his biceps, which serve as a [[Goldsign]] of his sect. As a combatant, he has experience fighting the [[Dawnwing Sect]] and possesses the ability to utilize a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] for rapid movement. His techniques include the [[Harbinger of the Storm]], which summons a massive storm by manipulating [[wind]], [[water]], and lightning [[aura]]. During combat, his [[dragon]] has been observed feeding on purple lightning spirits. Calan served as a teammate and sect brother to others in his group, though he eventually met his end after being pierced by the [[flying sword]] [[Wavedancer]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Calan Archer possesses Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns that appear as scripted rings of blue-gold lightning. He also has seven [[jade rings]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A member of the [[Stormcallers]], Calan uses Storm madra{{!}}storm madra and can conjure a lightning [[dragon]] that feeds on purple lightning spirits. His repertoire includes the [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] for speed, various [[Ruler techniques]] to spread storms, and [[soulfire]]. He also utilizes [[Striker techniques]] and is proficient with blades.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A member of the [[Stormcallers]] and a [[Dreadgod cultist]], Calan Archer is a sect brother to [[Therian Nills]] who possesses Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns resembling scripted rings of blue-gold lightning. While meditating in his waiting room, he entered an arena battle against [[Yerin]], where he utilized a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] to flee and employed various techniques, including a [[Ruler technique]] to spread a storm and [[soulfire]] to repel an [[Archlord]]'s power. During his time in the arena, he also competed against Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara by conjuring a lightning [[dragon]] that fed on a purple lightning [[spirit]]. Previously, Calan had encountered [[Reigan Shen]] and participated in an ambush against [[Mercy]] and Akura Pride{{!}}Pride as part of a group under the [[Sage of Red Faith]].}}
